scripts.typecheck: nx run-many --target=typecheck --exclude @mgc/root 2>/dev/null || (npx tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/gui/tsconfig.json --noEmit)
scripts.pub-options: npx nx run @migptgui/options:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/options
scripts.pub-options-preview: npx nx run @migptgui/options-with-preview:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/options-with-preview
scripts.pub-gui: npx nx run @migptgui/gui:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/gui
scripts.pub-controller: npx nx run @migptgui/controller:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/controller
scripts.pub-server-api: npx nx run @migptgui/server:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/server
scripts.pub-server: npx nx run migpt-server:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w apps/server
scripts.pub-cli: npx nx run migpt-cli:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w apps/cli
